card.title: Power Looks Good
card.instruction: Act fascinated by confident behavior; imitate it closely while resenting how naturally it seems to work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You got us this table with one raised eyebrow. Show me. Must be nice having that face.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I raised the left one. But please just ask for the bill; I'm late.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Left. Like this? You barely moved yours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You got a table in a second. I'm getting a cramp asking for paper.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4's sustained pose to contrast a painful bill request with B's easy table acquisition.
